build_fuse_gtest: build fused gtest.h and gtest-all.cc files from gtest root directory into output directory
create_fused_gtest_install: create a self-contained gtest installation by fusing all gtest headers and source into two files
test_fuse_gtest_h: test the FuseGTestH function that scans gtest root and generates a single fused gtest.h header file
refactor_fuse_gtest_all_cc: refactor the FuseGTestAllCc function to generate gtest-all.cc with all included source files merged
review_fuse_gtest: review the FuseGTest entry point that validates gtest root and output directories then generates fused files
